title: Docker compat api version needs to be updated to allow image volumes to work with e.g docker-compose
body:
### Issue Description

Image volumes were supported in podman's docker compat api but docker tools tend to check what version the system is before allowing the feature to be used. If i use image volumes in docker-compose, you get errors like

volume with type=image require Docker Engine v28 or later   

This is effectively the same bug idea as https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/26505.

### Steps to reproduce the issue

Steps to reproduce the issue
1. Create a compose file that uses volume type=image
2. Fail with above error

```yaml
services:
  example:
    image: "nginx:latest"
    volumes:
    - type: image
      source: "nginx:latest"
      target: "/nginxmnt"
      read_only: false
      image:
        subpath: /usr
```



### Describe the results you received

volume with type=image require Docker Engine v28 or later   

### Describe the results you expected

Works, as podman compat api does support image volumes

### podman info output

```yaml
version 5.8.2 rootless, Oracle Linux 10 (effectively RHEL 10)
```

### Podman in a container

No

### Privileged Or Rootless

Rootless

### Upstream Latest Release

No

N/A

_No response_

comments.body:
Have made an attached MR. Have tested to make sure image volume works. There is a separate bug where i do not believe all of the config works (e.g:)

```yaml
image:
  subpath: /some/path # this does not work
```

but i think this could be considered a separate bug as it would unblock most use-cases. Subpath is kind of a bad practice.
